# The paths that can change a convergence leg's verdict.
#
# Read by `.github/scripts/kick-convergence.sh` (Main dispatches the convergence suites
# only for a push that touches one of these) and by `.github/scripts/convergence-bisect.sh`
# (which bisects only over commits that do). One list, so the two cannot disagree about
# what a "pipeline commit" is: a commit the dispatcher skipped is one the bisect also skips.
#
# `dir/**` is everything under `dir/`; anything else is an exact file path — the
# `.github/actions/changed-paths/matches.sh` dialect.
geodata/src/main/**
common/src/main/**
identity/src/main/**
scrapers/src/main/**
worker/src/main/**
worker/src/fixtures/**
testkit/src/main/**
itkit/src/main/**
# The tools a leg's takes check and hard-cluster ratchet run (scripts/ci/identity-takes-check.sh, scripts/hard-clusters.sh):
# their flags, outputs and exit codes are part of the verdict, though they live outside src/main.
worker/src/it/scala/IdentityResolveDump.scala
worker/src/test/scala/scripts/UnmatchedClustersRatchet.scala
worker/src/it/scala/HardClusterRecord.scala
worker/src/it/scala/HardClusterPasses.scala
worker/src/test/scala/scripts/BuildHardClusters.scala
# e2e dependsOn(web): the legs read their schedules through MovieControllerService, and
# nothing else of the web. Its file and every web source it reaches, which
# ConvergenceDispatchGateSpec recomputes, so a new dependency cannot go unlisted.
web/src/main/scala/controllers/MovieControllerService.scala

# The identity takes check every hermetic convergence row runs after its suite: the scripts, and the judgements
# that accept a move and that the suspect gate reads (an acceptance re-runs the lane, which turns the check green again).
scripts/ci/identity-takes-check.sh
# ...and the history floor it reads on github.com: a status older than it counts as none when the base is picked
.github/github-takes-history-floor
# the incremental = whole gate beside it: its replay harness, the allow-lists and known-flips baseline it reads, and
# the unmatched families both checks read (ConvergenceReuse's ListedInputs: every input of either check listed)
